name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low light and keeps focus on the data, matching Manus’ competitive analysis. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode for readability in bright environments, but the toggle keeps the decision flexible.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes bury errors in data—low contrast hides outliers and misaligned values. A light theme with high-contrast accents keeps errors visible while reducing glare; settle it with A/B tests on error detection speed in both modes.
